name: Can aging-in-place renovations increase my home's value?

mainEntity.name: Can aging-in-place renovations increase my home's value?

acceptedAnswer.text: While the primary goal of aging-in-place renovations is often safety and comfort, some modifications can also increase a home's value. Features like a universally accessible bathroom, a no-step entry, or well-designed open floor plans appeal to a broader range of buyers, including families with young children or individuals with temporary mobility issues. Quality, well-executed renovations that are aesthetically pleasing tend to offer better returns on investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, well-executed aging-in-place renovations, especially accessible bathrooms or no-step entries, can appeal to a broader buyer market and potentially increase home value.
